title: Q-PROMO-mcp-registry: keep the mcp-registry promotion channel live
body:
**Owner:** marketing-manager
**Trigger:** every promote --plan pass
**Done check:** grep:ops/promotion/outcomes.jsonl::"channel": "mcp-registry"
**Prediction:** promotion_outcomes_recorded >= 1 within 336 h
**Status:** closed

Route: .github/workflows/mcp-registry.yml. Signal back: registry search returns io.github.ultrastable/ultrastable; agent hits on /mcp. Record the result with `python3 -m foundation promote --outcome mcp-registry --kind listed|silent`; the outcome re-weights the channel.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 169.6 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
